body:
A small mod that adds a death zone in which if you want to enter you have to drink a special potion that works for 30 minutes.
### **_You can set the death zone with the command /border setup < number >100 >_** .
To craft a potion you have to add an external crafting, e.g. CraftTweaker.
Additionally, SztulagzCoin bronze silver gold cash is available.
The mod is recommended to download if you want a small economy on the server or to keep players in a smaller area :D
